The original video critic reports video-critic-<role>.json are now video-r0-critic-<role>-recheck.json, unchanged apart from a recheck record pointing at this topic's critic-<role>.json.] Accept the finding as a real course-document inconsistency; no companion change, so no fixedInSha256. Latest recheck authoring/evidence/html-css-js/html-and-css/the-box-model/video-r2-critic-education-recheck.json (on the current bytes) keeps it open at residual low severity. Facts: the companion assigns 8.37 optional watch minutes (line 39); intake.md line 362 (S20 Concept row) says the Short video 8 block holds topic videos summing to 8 minutes or less and 'a video that does not fit is recorded absent with the reason'; video-curation.md (section 'Standard Concept-day Short video block') reports S20 at 25.45 optional minutes, 'no: over 8 minutes, self-paced outside the block'. This 8.37-minute whole-video assignment exceeds the 8-minute block on its own, so it could not fill the block even as the only S20 video; it stays within the topic budget of 10 minutes (gate T17). Reconciler judgement: acceptable as shipped and not blocking. (1) html-artifact-contract.md, section video-artifact.md: a linked video is optional navigation, and the companion says the page teaches every objective without it. (2) The intake itself treats a video companion's existence as separate from block scheduling: legend V (line 138) requires the companion when a suitable verified video exists, line 358 says topic videos are scheduled only in the Concept-day block (so the S21 Lab-day video companions are already unscheduled), and the same paragraph lets an artifact count 'as additional time when no block can hold it'. The S20 'recorded absent' clause is therefore read as governing what fills the block, not whether the companion exists. (3) video-curation.md adds these minutes to no topic budget, day template or track, and names the subset that could fill the block. I record that, for these companions, the unscheduled-optional-link framing in video-curation.md governs over the literal S20 absent clause. Residual, open and non-blocking: intake.md is unchanged (I may not edit it) and still reads as quoted. A course-scoped intake amendment is needed to say that topic video companions are unscheduled optional links and that the Short video block, if scheduled, takes a fitting subset; that amendment should also cover S22, S24 and S25, which video-curation.md also reports over 8 minutes. Until it lands, no repository video is scheduled in the S20 Short video block.
